e: The correct answer is Statement of balances of "Charged Off" imprest on 31st March. Annexure 'C' of the Annual Statement of Stores Transactions (S.3001) comprises the statement of balances of 'Charged Off' imprest on 31st March. This annexure reports the imprest position at year end. q: A review of the balances of the material-at-site account for the year should be prepared in the form shown as Annexure 'B' of Annual Statement of Stores Transactions (S.3001) which comprise of:

options.A: The analysis of stores balances for each division on completed works
options.C: to be started and works not to be done

e: The correct answer is (D) All of the above. This is a concept-clarity question. q: The Statement of 'Annual Statement of Stores Transactions' is accompanied by a 'Note' prepared by COS, duly certified by Chief Accounts Officer consists of:

options.A: The balance of stores for the last 10 years, in order to show the fluctuations
options.B: The increase or decrease under each individual head of Stores in paragraph 201 in the year review and the reasons for the same
options.C: The details of the verifications of stores carried out during the year

e: The correct answer is All of the above. The 'Note' accompanying the Annual Statement of Stores Transactions, prepared by the COS and duly certified by the Chief Accounts Officer, consists of the balance of stores for the last 10 years showing fluctuations, the increase or decrease under each individual head of stores in the year under review with reasons, and the details of stores verifications carried out during the year. All elements are included.
